name: Thundering Hearts
summary: A researcher studying abomination creation seeks a massive heart from Stormheart, a thunder lizard in Thousand Needles. The heart is needed for the researcher’s work.

sections.title: A Large Heart
sections.body: The researcher has studied notes on creating an abomination and believes the work requires a massive heart. Stormheart, a thunder lizard said to patrol the canyon edge in Thousand Needles, seems the right size. The researcher warns that Stormheart is not docile.

sections.title: The Heart
sections.body: Stormheart’s heart still carries electrical pulses. The researcher says it appears to be the specified size and will be added to the abomination.

faq.answer: A researcher studying the secrets of abomination creation wants Stormheart’s heart for an abomination.
Stormheart patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles.
Stormheart is a thunder lizard of impressive size.
The researcher’s notes indicate that abomination creation requires a massive heart.

faq.q: What does the researcher know about the heart?
faq.answer: The researcher says the heart still has electrical pulses and appears to be the size specified in the notes.
